description: 被噪音、停车、垃圾困扰时，先礼后兵：说清影响、提出方案、划出边界，不把关系彻底搞僵。

targetChunks.en: Sorry to bother you — do you have a minute?
targetChunks.zh: 不好意思打扰，你有空吗？
targetChunks.note: 上门沟通先降低对抗感；bother 用在这里很自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Sorry to bother you — do you have a minute?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 不好意思打扰，你有空吗？

targetChunks.en: The music's been keeping me up at night.
targetChunks.note: keep someone up = 让人睡不着；说影响，不骂人。
targetChunks.exampleEn: The music's been keeping me up at night.

targetChunks.en: I don't want to make a big deal out of it.
targetChunks.note: make a big deal out of = 小题大做；给对方台阶。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I don't want to make a big deal out of it, but it's been every night.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我不想把事闹大，但已经连续好几晚了。

targetChunks.en: Would you mind keeping it down after ten?
targetChunks.note: Would you mind + doing 是最礼貌的请求之一。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Would you mind keeping it down after ten?

targetChunks.en: I've asked a couple of times already.
targetChunks.note: 表明不是第一次，边界更清楚；语气要稳。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I've asked a couple of times already, so I wanted to talk in person.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我已经说过几次了，所以想当面聊聊。

targetChunks.note: 比 That's unfair 温和，适合面对面冲突。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm not sure that's fair — it's affecting the whole floor.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我觉得这不太公平，整层楼都受影响。

targetChunks.note: 把对抗转成共同解决问题。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Can we find a compromise that works for both of us?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我们能找个双方都能接受的折中吗？

targetChunks.en: I'd appreciate a heads-up next time.
targetChunks.note: 对可预期的噪音/施工，提前告知就能减少冲突。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'd appreciate a heads-up next time you have people over.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 下次有人来聚会，能提前说一声吗？

targetChunks.en: If it happens again, I'll have to take it further.
targetChunks.zh: 再发生的话，我就得往上反映了。
targetChunks.note: take it further = 升级处理（物业/房东/投诉）；最后通牒但不骂人。
targetChunks.exampleEn: If it happens again, I'll have to take it further with the building.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 再发生的话，我就得找物业处理了。

targetChunks.note: keep it civil = 保持礼貌、不升级；冲突中给自己也给对方台阶。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Let's keep it civil — I'm not trying to start a fight.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 别撕破脸，我不是来吵架的。

targetChunks.note: hear someone out = 听完对方；收尾保留关系。

roleplay.promptZh: 楼上邻居连续几晚深夜放音乐。你上门沟通：说清影响、提出具体请求、听对方解释，并约定再发生怎么办。
roleplay.promptEn: Your upstairs neighbor has been playing loud music late at night. Talk it through: state the impact, make a specific request, listen, and agree on consequences.
goals: 先降低对抗感再说影响
提出具体时间和音量请求
约定再发生时的处理方式

script.speaker: you
script.en: Sorry to bother you — do you have a minute?
script.zh: 不好意思打扰，你有空吗？

script.speaker: you
script.en: The music's been keeping me up at night. I don't want to make a big deal out of it, but it's been every night.
script.zh: 音乐吵得我睡不着。我不想把事闹大，但已经连续好几晚了。

script.speaker: other
script.en: Oh — I didn't realize it was that loud.

script.speaker: you
script.en: Would you mind keeping it down after ten? I've asked a couple of times already.
script.zh: 十点后能小声点吗？我已经说过几次了。

script.speaker: other
script.en: Fair enough. I'll turn it down.

script.speaker: you
script.en: I'd appreciate a heads-up next time. Can we find a compromise?
script.zh: 下次能提前说一声吗？我们能找个折中吗？

script.speaker: other
script.en: Sure. I'll text you if we're having people over.
script.zh: 可以。有人来聚会我就给你发消息。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Thanks for hearing me out. If it happens again, I'll have to take it further, but I'd rather keep it civil.
script.zh: 谢谢你听我说。再发生我就得找物业了，不过我更希望别撕破脸。
